svg.aria-label: cold-read, an LLM skill. A blind pass on finished work before it leaves your hands: the rubric first, one isolated reader per lens, any quoted fail blocks, two rounds then stop. Shown as a document in a cold glass chamber, read by five orbiting lenses; one beam turns red on the flawed line.
